title: Crucible SDK capability manifest
description: What one SDK declares to the conformance driver (docs/testing/sdk-conformance.md).

sdk.description: Report name; the report files are <sdk>.jsonl and <sdk>.md

runner.description: Program and arguments, resolved against the driver's working directory. The program name crucible-sdk-driver means the running driver

throw_outcome.description: What a tool handler's exception becomes: an isError result (tool_error) or a JSON-RPC error -32603 (internal)

progress_count.description: observed: crucible.mcp.progress.count equals the progress notifications sent; unobserved: the key is absent

case.description: A case id (scenario@variant) or a scenario id
